list_credential_helpers: list the git credential helpers configured for a repository folder
set_git_credential: save a username and token pair in git credential for the Hugging Face Hub registry
unset_git_credential: erase credentials from git credential for the Hugging Face Hub registry
parse_credential_output: parse git config output to extract configured credential helper names
run_subprocess_git_config: run git config --list in a folder and parse credential helper entries
